name: directives/at-layer-reordering
description: User `@layer base | components | utilities` blocks are pulled into the matching `@tailwind X;` slot regardless of source order. Direct port of upstream's `expandTailwindAtRules.js` layer-position semantics. The `@layer base` block here appears AFTER `@tailwind base;` in source — the oracle still places it inside the base slot. Likewise `@layer utilities` lands inside the utilities slot.
